description: Python script for manipulating PDF and FDF files, including extracting form field keys and filling PDF forms using pdftk.

methods.name: output_field
methods.description: Encodes a field name for FDF format.

methods.name: extract_keys
methods.description: Extracts form field keys from lines of FDF data.

methods.name: write_field
methods.description: Writes a single form field to output in FDF format.

methods.name: write_fields
methods.description: Writes multiple form fields to output in FDF format.

methods.name: extract_keys_from_pdf
methods.description: Uses pdftk to generate FDF data from a PDF and extracts form field keys.

methods.name: fill_pdf
methods.description: Fills a PDF form with specified fields using pdftk.

methods.name: testfill_pdf
methods.description: Test function to fill a PDF form with its own field keys.
